scope: Theorem 1.2 (Uniform bound over all ranks) of the manuscript “A power saving for planar halving lines” (preprints/A-power-saving-for-planar-halving-lines-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 183 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 61d7aa1ffad4b796), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are absolute constants ε > 0 and C < ∞ such that for every integer N ≥ 1, every generic N-point planar configuration P, and every integer 0 ≤ k ≤ N, Sk(P) ≤ CN4/3−ε .
